eps.d: Francois arrives at the beleagured Fort of Casal where the Spaniards are doing all in their power to destroy it before a truce can be called.
The Chevalier de Recci disappears from Casal with unexpected consequences.
Francois de Recci and Guillot meet a man who is destined to become on of the great figures in the history of France.
Francois and Guillot are taken prisoner by bandits and meet the beautiful Isabelle and her father Duc de Sospel.
Isabelle suspects that the merchant who rescued her is not all he seems to be.
Francois,on his quest for the agent who will help him to get his message through to the French, falls in with a group of strolling players.
The Chevalier de Recci receives his orders from the Cardinal's agent.
The Spanish Commander holds the Duke responsible for Recci's escape.
The Chevalier makes a final effort to reach the French army in a desperate attempt to save the besieged French tropps in Casal.

Francois de Recci has almost completed his task but Alonso stands in his path.
The Chevalier de Recci returns home with the faithful Guillot after a long absence. This rarely seen final episode is presented in its orginal French language with English subtitles.
